title: Radiation-shielding glass with tailored Al-doped zinc oxide (AZO) coatings for durable space photovoltaic modules
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42720-42727
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06756A, Paper

Dajeong Kim, Yerang Park, Hyun-Beom Shin, Ho Kwan Kang, Da Young Kwon, Jae-ik Han, Nochang Park, Yonghwan Lee
Thermally annealed AZO-coated glass provides effective electron radiation shielding, significantly mitigating efficiency degradation in III–V space photovoltaic modules under electron irradiation.
